name: neulens-server
description: Backend API for NeuLens - Neurocognitive Screening Platform (Engineered by Google Antigravity)
author: Google Antigravity Agent & NeuLens Team

scripts.predeploy: npm run build && npm run prisma:generate && npm run migrate:deploy
scripts.start-prod: npm run build && npm run prisma:generate && npm run migrate:deploy && npm start
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run prisma:generate && npm run migrate:deploy
scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run prisma:generate && npm test
scripts.verify-ci: npm run build && npm run prisma:generate && npm test && echo CI_OK
scripts.verify-ci-healthcheck: npm run build && npm run prisma:generate && npm test && bash healthcheck.sh && echo CI_HEALTHCHECK_OK
